scope: Sete novas linhas de pré-evoluções e reunião da linha Trancoura existente; 24 pré-evoluções no catálogo, 21 novas artes. Sem integração.
crystal: Proposta: cristal ancestral adquirido na forma adulta; nenhum novo fragmento/alma nas formas anteriores.

families.name: Vesperálito
families.story: Aprender a sustentar: de abrigo dobrado a guardião que contém impactos.
forms: BEBÊ: palm-sized folded plum paper shelter-pod whose living face IS the front ivory fold, two triangular soft fold ears, violet curious eyes, no neck, no armor, no developed legs, just two tiny tucked support tabs. One short petrol/mint rabiola with small two-tone terminal. Broad ivory upper fold protects its sleepy face. Compact simple few masses, NOT baby lion or adult armor.

CRIANÇA: curious four-legged squat paper cub, low shoulders and broad little paws, short inquisitive mask-beast muzzle with violet eyes. Plum inflatable belly, ivory half-moon back canopy on two bamboo ribs, petrol cheek marking, mint knots. No adult towering arch, no heavy greaves. It braces front paws while lifting a small canopy edge, shelter-maker body. Single short rabiola.

JOVEM: lean long-legged quadruped interceptor, rising front shoulder arch but light narrow pelvis, youthful narrow angular mask-beast face with violet eyes. Plum smooth membranes, two high ivory/petrol shoulder awnings with sweeping bamboo rib, copper edge, mint knots; ONE pair of partial front guards, rear legs free. Athletic three-quarter bracing turn, four paws visible. Chest keel small and EMPTY, no gem. Not the huge fully armored adult; posture learning to receive an impact.

families.name: Nimbálio
families.story: Da deriva involuntária ao domínio das correntes; as abas crescem e articulam.
forms: BEBÊ: very simple living wind-envelope, rounded triangular ivory/navy body and face fused, cyan eyes, tiny red cheek crease, two small lateral folded corner flaps as lift tabs, no limbs or neck, NO adult armor or horns. One short braided navy rabiola red-ivory terminal. Slight uneven hovering wobble, compact buoyant paper shape, not bird or manta animal.

CRIANÇA: lively limbless aerial ray-like living kite with soft short central body, two broad rounded red/ivory/navy lateral paper sails tensioned by one visible bamboo crossbow each. Small curious cyan eye-mask integrated into front fold, no beak. One short rabiola. Sails cup air upward, small belly keel, no armor. Wider than baby but soft simple construction; no legs, hands, realistic ray skin.

JOVEM: fast slender limbless aerial living kite, narrow long central keel, small focused cyan-eyed mask face and bifurcated folded brow, two forward-swept red/navy/ivory sails with scalloped aerodynamic negative spaces and bamboo leading spars, mint anchor knots. Sparse copper rim guards ONLY on leading corners, open unarmored chest keel NO CRYSTAL. One rabiola steering visibly from rear. Banked controlled S-turn, agile silhouette distinct from adult's massive ceremonial broad mantle.

families.name: Ofirante
families.story: De fita que escorrega a serpente que redireciona força com o corpo.
forms: BEBÊ: simple short curled crimson-and-ivory living paper comma, head/body fused in a plump rolled ribbon, emerald gentle eyes, tiny mouth, a single broad forehead crease. NO arms, legs, teeth, armor, large hood or crystal. One little mint knot joins the short body to one red-ivory rabiola terminal. Head-like kite fold with a short curled bottom, not a realistic baby cobra.

CRIANÇA: inquisitive short limbless ribbon serpent in one loose loop, broad ivory belly fold, crimson top, green eyes, short rounded folded reptile muzzle and two little side collar flaps. One continuous bamboo edging under rear loop, mint neck knot, one attached terminal rabiola. No adult massive armor, crown or crystal. Playful curling defensive loop, no arms/legs, smooth folded paper.

JOVEM: long agile limbless living kite-serpent raised in a flowing S with lower open coil, youthful angular reptilian skull with emerald eyes and TWO small fangs. Two swept crimson-ivory collar vanes only half adult width, sparse copper-rim ivory guards along outer curve, broad unstriated crimson paper throat and cream belly; curved bamboo edge and mint knots. NO massive adult multiple coils or large plated chest, no crystal. Single attached rabiola. Spring-loaded redirecting posture, anatomical continuous snake, no limbs.

families.name: Canticripta
families.story: De pequeno ressonador a caçador que afina e interrompe vibrações.
forms: BEBÊ: simple little living paper seed-resonator, one rounded indigo/ivory ovoid folded body with integrated magenta-eyed face, TWO short bamboo antennae, six tiny tucked tab-feet (three each side), no raptorial blades yet, NO armor or wings/crystal. One jade folded back flap with a curved cutout like first reed and one short attached rabiola. Gentle listening head tilt; cute but clean manga not western cartoon.

CRIANÇA: small lively mantis-cricket paper nymph with six limbs: FOUR walking legs supporting compact indigo paper abdomen and TWO short grasping forearms folded like tuning forks, not huge sickles. Two bamboo antennae, magenta compound eyes, ivory angular face, ONE PAIR of short closed jade reed panels on back. Sparse knots, no armor, no crystal. Alert listening pose with asymmetrical antenna directions, all six roots clear.

JOVEM: agile mantis paper musician-hunter, SIX limbs exactly: four slender walking legs and two long but slender raptorial tuning blades. Youthful ivory triangular insect face, magenta compound eyes, TWO antennae. Two narrow jade/ivory dorsal reed vanes partially opening, indigo broad smooth segmented abdomen, sparse copper wrist and shin edging, mint hinge knots, no adult huge scythes/massive armor/crystal. One complete rabiola. One blade touches other as tuning action, both roots visible.

families.name: Grifarca
families.story: Da cabeça-pipa ao vigia alado; aprender a equilibrar apoio, salto e voo.
forms: BEBÊ: a tiny broad kite-shaped living chick-face with NO separate torso, tiny folded dark beak, sapphire gentle eyes, two ivory/sapphire folded cheek wings functioning as tiny lift flaps, TWO tiny tucked feet-tabs only. One short navy rabiola with bilobed paper terminal, one copper bamboo top bow. No armor/crystal/real feather texture. Few clean large shapes, one slight split head crest.

CRIANÇA: curious small quadruped gryphon cub made of taut sapphire/ivory paper, short folded avian beak, expressive sapphire eyes, three broad cheek vanes, two small folded wing buds, FOUR clear feet (front bird talons, rear broad cub paws). Low round body, one back bamboo rib, copper knot accent, ONE tail-rabiola bilobed tip. No armor/crystal. Playful hop preparing to glide, wing roots distinct from forelegs.

JOVEM: lean adolescent living paper gryphon, FOUR rooted limbs with slender front talons/rear paws, TWO medium-length wings of few broad sapphire/ivory paper blades with bamboo leading ribs, smaller youthful angular beak head and split crest, sapphire eyes. Long athletic torso, only small copper-rim shoulder collars/foreleg guards, smooth broad paper belly, one bilobed rabiola. No crystal, no heavy adult breastplate. Low landing/interception pose with wings swept up, not adult shrunk.

families.name: Gevoraz
families.story: De farejador hesitante a perseguidor capaz de encurralar sem perder o controle.
forms: BEBÊ: compact living rust-red paper pouch with face integrated, little cream folded muzzle, pale pink curious eyes, two oversized floppy charcoal/ivory triangular ear flaps, TWO little tucked feet-tabs, no separate neck or developed body. One short braided rabiola with red torn-chevron paper terminal. Not scary, no skull mask/armor/crystal. Few broad folds, one little tooth only if subtle.

CRIANÇA: inquisitive four-legged folded-paper hound cub, rust red body broad smooth surfaces, cream folded muzzle, pale pink eyes, angular charcoal ear tips, disproportionately broad sniffing forepaws but short hindlegs. Three soft charcoal/ivory shoulder ruff vanes, ONE narrow bamboo back brace and ONE braided rabiola. No bone armor, crystal or adult predator head. Head lowered tracking, ears alert, living kite nose/muzzle not real dog fur.

JOVEM: lanky fast quadruped tracking beast, higher shoulders/slender hips, four long rooted legs, narrow elongated cream folded muzzle and pale icy pink eyes, charcoal ridge of SEVEN broad paper mane blades, smooth rust-red paper belly/flanks. Sparse bone-gray/copper forearm/shin guards, not enormous adult armor or skull mass; no crystal. Long braided rabiola ends a red-ivory split vane. Low tense cornering pose, expressive alert hunter not evil werewolf, no muscle fibers.

families.name: Makaréu
families.story: De flutuador de margem a condutor das correntes profundas.
forms: BEBÊ: very simple plump seafoam living paper float, head/body fused, a tiny short curled snout crease, silvery turquoise gentle eyes, TWO tiny webbed fin-tabs only, NO hind legs, no horns/armor/crystal. Tail-body is short with a single coral/navy fan fold, separate ONE small string rabiola attached from back ending tiny ivory kite. Few broad folds, not detailed natural sea animal. Friendly buoyant diagonal pose.

CRIANÇA: playful compact aquatic living kite creature, short seafoam rounded body flowing continuously into short broad coral/navy fan tail, TWO webbed little forelimbs only, no hindlegs. Short upward-curled trunk muzzle, silvery turquoise eyes, TWO tiny folded horn buds, little coral gillfans, navy shoulder stripe on taut paper. One bamboo curved upper support and ONE short attached rabiola distinct from caudal fan. No armor or crystal. Paddling turn, no realistic skin.

JOVEM: agile elongated but compact aquatic paper beast, TWO strong webbed forelimbs only, continuous seafoam body into a large coral/navy caudal fan, narrow young head with short curved trunk, TWO half-grown cream swept curled horns, silvery turquoise eyes and coral gillfan cheeks. Two light indigo/coral shoulder guards and bamboo side rib, smooth belly, NO adult huge collar armor or crystal. One thin rabiola attached above tail root separate from body-tail. Strong swimming turn, coherent no hindlegs.
